sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: BFA title sheet. Design team: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc. (EOR/Prime), Hoggard/Eure Associates P.C. (surveyor), Broyles and Associates, PC (structural). Client: Elizabeth River Crossings. Project location shown on vicinity/location maps: Portsmouth area at intersection near Downtown Tunnel portal. Drawing index lists 25 sheets total (G-001 through E-507). Drawing dated 03/22/2026, Final Submittal. Contract No. 501-B5501-001.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Standard electrical legend. New devices include: fluorescent lighting fixtures (E-101 schedule), emergency fixtures, duplex 20A/125VAC convenience receptacles, single-pole switches (20A, 120/277V), equipment connections, electrical panel/board (208Y/120V), LAN system outlet, junction boxes, combination power/communications manhole, CCTV cameras. Existing items to be removed or remain also noted. System appears to be 120/208V 3-phase service.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Shows overall site electrical layout. Key elements: existing electrical manhole (Cabinet 264-13) providing 100A, 3Ø, 4W feeder to new inspection station panelboard. (2) 2-inch conduits run to new building — one for power/control wiring, one spare. Existing inspection station to be demolished; utilities relocated to new building. Existing camera, signage, conduit to be relocated/rerouted. Notes: existing VDOT inspection station must remain in operation through construction until utilities transferred. Scale 1"=20'-0".

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL FLOOR PLAN — DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Demolition plan for existing inspection station building. Items to be removed: existing lighting fixtures, existing 100A load center (120/208V, 1Ø, 3W), cameras, control station, mechanical equipment connections, conduit and wire, power feeder, junction box/conduit. Existing control/power cabinet to remain. Scale 1/2"=1'-0".

sheets.title: LIGHTING, POWER AND SPECIAL SYSTEMS FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: New electrical floor plan for replacement inspection station (Porta-King RR-PC167SW). Electrical panel 'A' inside building. Key notes: 100A, 3Ø, 4W feeder from existing Cabinet Box 264-13; control box per sheets E-502 through E-508; (2) 2" conduits — one with control wiring, one spare; 4x4 NLar 3R junction box for alarm bells/device. CCTV cameras relocated from existing ERC field station to new building, with waterproof WP junction boxes. Also shows 480V submersible pump circuit (1-HP, 120/240V, 1Ø) run below grade from existing electrical manhole — plumbing lift station.

sheets.title: STRUCTURAL GENERAL NOTES (page 1)
sheets.reading_notes: Structural design notes by Broyles and Associates, PC. Design per 2021 Virginia Construction Code and IBC 2021. Design loads: First Floor 60 PSF LL, Roof 20 PSF LL. Ground snow 35 PSF, flat roof snow 24.5 PSF. Wind: Vult=120 MPH (Vasd=93 MPH), Exposure C, Risk Category II, Internal Pressure ±0.18. Seismic: SDC A, light-framed walls with shear panels. Rain intensity 3.64 in/hr. Foundations designed for 1,500 PSF allowable soil bearing. All concrete 4,500 PSI (exterior slab/turned edge). Structural fill compacted to 95% per ASTM D698.

sheets.title: STRUCTURAL GENERAL NOTES (page 2)
sheets.reading_notes: Components and cladding wind loads chart (zones 1–5, roof and wall). Special inspection requirements (per IBC §1704/1705): earthwork, concrete reinforcing/placement, post-installed adhesive anchors. Abbreviation legend.

sheets.title: FOUNDATION PLAN AND SECTIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Foundation plan at 1/2"=1'-0". Concrete slab-on-grade: 24'-0" O-O x 15'-0" O-O (360 SF slab). 6" thick slab reinforced with #4@12" EW over 15 mil vapor barrier and 4" porous fill. Turned-down slab edge 1'-0" wide x 2'-6" deep with (2)-#5 continuous. Pre-engineered building: Porta-King Model RR-PC167SW. C4x5.4 steel channel base frame by manufacturer. Anchor tabs 3"x3" provided by manufacturer. 1/2"ø galvanized adhesive anchors with 4" embedment (Hilti HY200 or equal). 1'-6" roof overhang noted. Roof overhang sidewalk slopes 1/8" per foot for drainage.

sheets.title: FLOOR PLAN AND ELEVATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Floor plan 1/2"=1'-0". Building footprint 19'-0" length x 16'-0" width (approximately 304 SF). Features: water heater, chase heater, wall-mounted heater (no bathroom — confirmed by RFP special condition). Sliding door. Steel-framed exterior walls with metal panels. Clear door openings 32" (ADA). Wall HVAC unit. Roof plan shows continuous gutter around perimeter, standing seam metal roofing over 3/4" treated plywood sheathing, (4) downspouts. CCTV cameras relocated to each corner. Speakers at each corner (coordinate with ERC). Elevations A through D shown. Safety glass (7'-6" and 8'-3.5" heights noted). VDOT signage to be relocated to exterior wall. Note: existing VDOT inspection station must remain in operation through construction until new utilities transferred.

conflict_flags.rationale: The S-101 slab dimension (24'x15'=360 SF) includes the turned-down edge perimeter which extends beyond the building footprint. The A-101 floor plan shows the actual building interior/footprint as 19'x16'. No single authoritative GSF figure stated in any text source. Both figures are approximate reads from drawing dimensions at medium depth.
